currentRoundInspection.method: Inspected frontage picture pixels and standard viewer PMTiles.
currentRoundInspection.placement: Inspected frontage picture supports red brick, three storeys, cream bands, mansard wings and curved octagonal dome assemblies. Standard PMTiles separates the western low-rise combined station building from long platform-roof polygons. Its319m long axis and71.7m combined depth locate an approximate32m-wide western historic-frontage strip; the asset covers this Marunouchi frontage, not all Tokyo Station. Native+X follows the southward frontage axis; native+Z faces the west-northwest plaza. Native source335m length is scaled to the mapped319m frontage reference. Standard PMTiles centre contact plane establishes the approximate working floor; sampled footing corners descend to surrounding grade, and high urban samples beneath the roof are suppressed only under bounded covered architecture. Coarse PMTiles city mounds are retained outside the model and are not claimed as accurate plaza grade. No precise frontage/member survey is claimed.

references.redistribution: Reference only; no picture pixels or third-party mesh embedded.

limitations: Approximate historic Marunouchi frontage only, located using inspected picture and standard viewer PMTiles; exact member footprints, thresholds and dome/pavilion dimensions are reconstructed.
Separate reviewed exterior recipe improves the previous draft. Its original builder and draft hash remain available; source and every browser level build deterministically from Git recipes.

Shared brick, limestone, slate and standing-seam textures; no unique image duplication. Clock/trim/dormer inventories and rear elevations are simplified; closed interiors, platform complex, Yaesu side and train traffic are excluded.

Bounded covered-floor opening avoids coarse urban terrain through the model and preserves raw surroundings. Footprint replacement stays off. No bespoke survey, engineering fidelity or physical-device timing is claimed.
